description:
Title: Service for Your Fridge

Your fridge produces strange noises.
You describe the symptoms, and send them together with the type of fridge to the central fridge service center.
They select a local service facility (which all have their own way of interacting with customers).
The service facility makes an appointment.
They arrive at a random time, and sometimes have to leave without repairing your fridge, because they need additional parts.
After your fridge is repaired, you have to confirm that it is OK again.
You can rate the service facility.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_FridgeService"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/fridge-service">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Symptoms" name="Symptoms and fridge type"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Request" name="Service request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Appointment" name="Appointment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RepairDone" name="Repair completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PartsNeeded" name="Additional parts needed"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FridgeService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Center" name="Central Fridge Service Center" processRef="Process_Center"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Local Service Facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Symptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type"
                      sourceRef="Send_Symptoms" targetRef="Start_Center_Request"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Request" name="Forward service request"
                      sourceRef="Send_Request_Facility" targetRef="Start_Facility_Request"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Appointment" name="Appointment offered"
                      sourceRef="Send_Appointment" targetRef="Receive_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RepairDone" name="Repair completed"
                      sourceRef="Send_Repair_Done" targetRef="Catch_Repair_Done"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PartsNeeded" name="Parts needed, visit unsuccessful"
                      sourceRef="Send_Parts_Needed" targetRef="Catch_Parts_Needed"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Customer -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Fridge makes strange noises"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Describe_Symptoms" name="Describe symptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Symptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Customer_Merge" name="Merge before awaiting appointment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Appointment" name="Receive appointment" messageRef="Msg_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Customer_Event" name="Repair outcome"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Repair_Done" name="Repair completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Repair_Done" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Parts_Needed" name="Additional parts needed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Parts_Needed" messageRef="Msg_PartsNeeded"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Confirm_Repair" name="Confirm fridge is working again"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Rate_Facility" name="Rate service facility"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Service completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_Describe_Symptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C2" sourceRef="Task_Describe_Symptoms" targetRef="Send_Symptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C3" sourceRef="Send_Symptoms" targetRef="Gateway_Customer_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C4" sourceRef="Gateway_Customer_Merge" targetRef="Receive_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C5" sourceRef="Receive_Appointment" targetRef="Gateway_Customer_Event"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C6" sourceRef="Gateway_Customer_Event" targetRef="Catch_Repair_Done"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C7" sourceRef="Gateway_Customer_Event" targetRef="Catch_Parts_Needed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C8" sourceRef="Catch_Repair_Done" targetRef="Task_Confirm_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C9" sourceRef="Task_Confirm_Repair" targetRef="Task_Rate_Facility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C10" sourceRef="Task_Rate_Facility" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C11" sourceRef="Catch_Parts_Needed" targetRef="Gateway_Customer_Merge"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Central service center -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Center" name="Central Fridge Service Center" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Center_Request" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Center_Request" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Select_Facility" name="Select local service facility"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Request_Facility" name="Forward request to facility" messageRef="Msg_Request"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Center" name="Request forwarded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_D1" sourceRef="Start_Center_Request" targetRef="Task_Select_Facility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_D2" sourceRef="Task_Select_Facility" targetRef="Send_Request_Facility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_D3" sourceRef="Send_Request_Facility" targetRef="End_Center"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Local service facility -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Local Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Facility_Request" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Facility_Request" messageRef="Msg_Request"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Appointment_Merge" name="Merge for appointment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Make_Appointment" name="Make appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Appointment" name="Send appointment to customer" messageRef="Msg_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Visit_Customer" name="Visit customer at arrival time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Repair_Split" name="Repair possible?"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Repair_Fridge" name="Repair fridge"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Repair_Done" name="Notify customer of completed repair" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Repaired" name="Fridge repaired"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Leave_Without_Repair" name="Leave without repairing"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Parts_Needed" name="Notify customer that parts are needed" messageRef="Msg_PartsNeeded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F1" sourceRef="Start_Facility_Request" targetRef="Gateway_Appointment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F2" sourceRef="Gateway_Appointment_Merge" targetRef="Task_Make_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F3" sourceRef="Task_Make_Appointment" targetRef="Send_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F4" sourceRef="Send_Appointment" targetRef="Task_Visit_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F5" sourceRef="Task_Visit_Customer" targetRef="Gateway_Repair_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F6" name="Repaired" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Split" targetRef="Task_Repair_Fridge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F7" sourceRef="Task_Repair_Fridge" targetRef="Send_Repair_Done"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F8" sourceRef="Send_Repair_Done" targetRef="End_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F9" name="Parts needed" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Split" targetRef="Task_Leave_Without_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F10" sourceRef="Task_Leave_Without_Repair" targetRef="Send_Parts_Needed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F11" sourceRef="Send_Parts_Needed" targetRef="Gateway_Appointment_Merge"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
